newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Aug index rises to 60.0.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Aug index rises to 60.0.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer rose to a seasonally adjusted 60.0 in August from 51.2 in July, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Friday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index fell to 51.8 in August from 53.0 in July.
The employment component of the barometer rose to 49.7 in August from 43.2 in July.

(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said production rose in August to the highest level since last October and called the increase a "fantastic rebound."
It said order backlog registered a major swing as the index ended its contraction and jumped to its October 1994 level.
The decline in employment slowed as that index approached neutral, it added.
The group also said the "breadth of inflation shrinks."
